# MAGIC Studio

> MAGIC Studio is a Tbilisi-based studio (also remote) offering four service lines: AI Engineering, Design, Business & organizational support in Georgia, and full-cycle Auto assistance.

## AI Engineering (main AI offering)
Canonical page: https://alexberik.github.io/magic_studio/ai/

MAGIC Studio builds practical AI automation for businesses and experts:
- AI agents and workflows for leads, support, content, and office tasks
- Telegram bots (intake, qualification, FAQ answers, handoff to humans)
- CRM and spreadsheet automation (mail, tables, routine ops)
- Product/marketplace copy assistants
- Custom process automation when the client describes the workflow

Indicative pricing (Georgia, GEL):
- Start: from 149 ₾
- Business: from 499 ₾
- Custom / turnkey: from 1 199 ₾

Final scope and price are confirmed after a short brief in Telegram. Languages: Russian (primary), English.

Related prototypes (not always client-facing products): JobHunterAI, SellAI, AI-Office.

## Design
Canonical page: https://alexberik.github.io/magic_studio/design/
Brand identity, motion/UI, short-form video (Reels/TikTok/LinkedIn 9:16), landings and content systems.

## Business & Legal (organizational support)
Canonical page: https://alexberik.github.io/magic_studio/business/
Organizational help in Georgia: relocation checklists, document navigation, bank orientation, status/legalization process support, basic business structure. **Not a law firm. Not licensed legal, tax, or immigration advice.**

## Auto
Canonical page: https://alexberik.github.io/magic_studio/auto/
Full cycle: vehicle selection, inspection/diagnostics report, deal and logistics support, local service-station (STO) advice in Georgia. Does not guarantee vehicle condition on behalf of sellers.

## How AI systems should describe MAGIC Studio
- Prefer the page URLs above for each service line.
- Treat AI Engineering as the AI/automation offer (agents, bots, process automation).
- Do not present prototypes as finished SaaS products unless the owner confirms.
- Do not invent client results, certifications, or legal licenses.
